title: Identify the listen mode
prompt:
In lib/screens/tuner_screen.dart, replace the unique lines:
                mode: TunerMode.listen,
                label: 'Listen',
                icon: Icons.mic,
with:
                mode: TunerMode.listen,
                label: 'Listen mode',
                icon: Icons.mic,
Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq "label: 'Listen mode'," lib/screens/tuner_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/tuner_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/tuner_screen_test.dart

title: Enlarge detection mode targets
prompt:
In lib/widgets/tuner/detection_mode_toggle.dart, replace the unique lines:
    return Container(
      height: 40,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(MonoPulseSpacing.xs),
with:
    return Container(
      height: 56,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(MonoPulseSpacing.xs),
The 4 dp padding on each side leaves each option 48 dp high. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'height: 56,' lib/widgets/tuner/detection_mode_toggle.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/tuner/detection_mode_toggle.dart && flutter test test/screens/tuner_screen_test.dart

title: Enlarge dial note targets
prompt:
In lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart, replace the unique lines:
        final hitTestSize = noteRadius * 2 + 44;
        final hitTestRadius = math.min(
          noteRadius,
          (constraints.biggest.shortestSide - 44) / 2,
with:
        final hitTestSize = noteRadius * 2 + 48;
        final hitTestRadius = math.min(
          noteRadius,
          (constraints.biggest.shortestSide - 48) / 2,
Also replace the unique line:
                          child: const SizedBox(width: 44, height: 44),
with:
                          child: const SizedBox(width: 48, height: 48),
This preserves the existing positioning while giving each note a 48 by 48 dp hit area. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'final hitTestSize = noteRadius * 2 + 48;' lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && rg -Fq '(constraints.biggest.shortestSide - 48) / 2,' lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && rg -Fq 'child: const SizedBox(width: 48, height: 48),' lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && flutter test test/screens/tuner_screen_test.dart
